text:
Alex Chen: Quick check — recruitment velocity for the DP private preview is slower than expected. 10 invites outstanding, 2 accepted, 1 declined. Can we triage blockers?
Maria Gomez: +1 seeing low replies. Anecdotally onboarding doc has a broken step, will link.
Jordan Blake: Also noticed the invite form asks for org size up front. A few contacts said it felt too salesy and dropped off.
Samir Patel: Slack invite delivery failing for some corporate domains (blocked by corp filters). I can add fallback email flow.
Alex Chen: @Samir please paste the failing domains. @Maria paste the broken step link here when you have it.
Samir Patel: domains: corpbyte.com, enterprise-inc.net — getting 403 on the invite redirect. Logs: `INVITE_ERR 403 redirect_blocked`
Iris (eng-bot): deploy-notify: onboarding-docs v2.1 deployed to staging at 2025-06-01T19:05Z
Maria Gomez: Onboarding doc step 3 (service account grant) had outdated role name. Fix PR up: `docs/onboard#142`
Jordan Blake: Suggest removing mandatory org-size from the initial form. Replace with optional dropdown + 'Prefer not to say'.
Alex Chen: Agreed. We should split outreach into two funnels: quick trial (no org-size, 1-click invite) vs deep DP (form with commitment).
Samir Patel: For quick trial, I'll add email fallback and a short instructions doc. ETA EOD.
Maria Gomez: For deep DP, propose acceptance criteria:
- commit to 4 weekly feedback sessions
- share 3 representative prompts/flows
- sign NDA + simple data handling checklist
Jordan Blake: Can we tighten the feedback ask to per-feature feedback rather than open-ended? e.g., response quality on two prompts, latency hit scenario, and error repro steps.
Alex Chen: Good call. Update acceptance criteria accordingly and make it clear in the invite copy.
Maria Gomez: New invite copy draft: "Try Redwood Private for 30 days — minimal setup, we ask for 4 short feedback sessions and 3 example use-cases. NDA required for deep previews." Will drop in Google doc.
Jordan Blake: Also propose a small incentive (cloud credits + early feature access) to improve conversion.
Samir Patel: I'll run a 24hr test: send 50 quick-trial invites with new copy + email fallback and report conversion.
Alex Chen: Let's meet 2pm PST today for a 30m triage. Agenda: invite copy, form changes, fallback flow, acceptance criteria. If we can get Samir's test data before the meeting that'd be ideal.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll update the onboarding doc PR and the invite doc before the sync.
Iris (eng-bot): calendar: 30m triage scheduled today 14:00 PST — attendees: Alex Chen, Maria Gomez, Jordan Blake, Samir Patel
Jordan Blake: :eyes: bringing a short A/B plan for the invite copy.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — objective is to bump week-1 convert from 18% -> 35% by the next outreach. Small bets, quick feedback loop.
Samir Patel: Logged test cohort as `dp-quick-test-2025-06-02` in tracking sheet. Will paste results in the channel when done.
Maria Gomez: Adding checklist for the DP success metrics: convert rate, onboarding completion %, feedback compliance (% who attend sessions), and NPS after week 2.
Alex Chen: Perfect. If anyone finds other blockers before the sync, ping me directly.
Jordan Blake: Will do.
Samir Patel: On it.
Maria Gomez: Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
